subject.title: Isolated cron lanes leak on claude-cli backend: queued_work_without_active_run → release_lane released=0, lanes accumulate until restart

question: Does current main still misclassify a fresh `cli_live:stream_progress` isolated cron turn or leave later isolated cron jobs unable to start after the merged lifecycle reliability changes?
rationale: The merged PR is strong provenance for the classifier and recovery class, but the reporter’s claimed downstream effect requires a current-main runtime observation before this issue can safely close.

options.title: Verify current-main cron lifecycle
options.body: Run the isolated `claude-cli` cron scenario and close this issue if fresh progress no longer triggers recovery and later runs still admit normally.

options.title: Split a remaining setup failure
options.body: If fresh-progress recovery is fixed but `runtime-plugins` stalls remain, retain only a new narrowly evidenced report for that independent startup path.

recommendation.title: Verify current-main cron lifecycle
